items.detail: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.

items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型作为长视距代理被部署，将跨MCP服务的各种工具编成可执行的工作流程。现有的MCP环境尺度方法以数据为中心：它们首先合成一个数据库和情景，然后从中获取工具和任务。因此，工具界面可能不匹配真实的界面，工具构成不基于执行，任务很少跨越一个以上的环境。我们提出"工具空间"，一个以工具为中心的框架来扭转这个顺序。 ToolSpace矿井数据、状态和重试来自相邻电话的依赖性，在实际MCP服务和开源代理公司的执行痕迹中，使用确定性规则而不是LLM判断，并将由此产生的加权工具组合图分组到环境中。数据库只针对状态变换环境进行合成，而查询和无国籍工具则重放记录的返回。 ToolSpace然后以回滚方式进行状态意识随机行走，将每个链条分解为自然语言任务，并进行基于断言的检查，只保留从初始状态成功重播的样本。该管道适用于自动化奔驰和Tau3-奔驰银行业务，生产更硬的Pro版本，7个前沿型号下降最多38.2点。在7个长视距工具使用基准中，TollectSpace将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从23.0提高到41.0平均分(43.2与RL)，GLM-5.2从44.6提高到56.6，与克劳德·奥普斯5持平。差距表明，被处决的目击证人的优势明显高于LLM判断的优势，而且随着数据和环境尺度的扩大，性能不断提高。

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26：统一实时端对端视野模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确，高效，简便的模型，以在各种硬件中部署。 YOLO家族因此被广泛部署，然而大多数YOLO探测器在推论上仍然依赖非最大压制，由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头，需要较长的训练时间表，可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务。我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26，这是一个统一的实时视野模型家族，通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性。 YOLO26为本土NMS无端对端推论使用双头设计，并完全去除DFL，产生一个没有约束的回归范围的较轻头。其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合的Muon-SGD优化器，根据大型语言模式培训加以调整；进步损失，将监督转向推论时间头；和STAL，一种标签分配策略，它保证对小物体的正面覆盖。除检测外，YOLO26还引入了特定任务头和损失设计，例如分解，提出估计和定向检测，在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益。家族跨越5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x)，支持检测，实例分解，在单一的管道中提出估计，分类，并定向检测，并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展，YOLOE-26，用于文本，视觉，以及即时的免费推断。在所有尺度上，YOLO26在COCO上以1.7至11.8 ms T4 TensorRT的耐久性达到40.9至57.5 mAP，将精度-常帕雷托正面推进到之前的实时探测器上，而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP。代码和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics。

items.detail: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
items.title_zh: 最低业务安全标准-图像技术报告
items.detail_zh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以产生从简单的组成到信息密集的图形的不同视觉内容，然而开放式的文本到图像模型仍然与密集的文本和复杂的布局相抗衡。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了MOSS-Image，一种开放的生成系统，将高真性视觉合成与意向意识组成相结合。首先，我们用精心设计的食谱，从头开始预先训练5B型单流扩散变压器(DIT)，使双语长式文本渲染和精确布局控制成为可能。第二，我们开发了一个意向意识的即时增强(PE)模块，将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规格。它们共同使MOSS-Image生成内容丰富且布局一致的图像。我们进一步引入了LongLongText Bench(LLTB)来评价长式英文和中文文本渲染，以及RealLayoutArena(RLA)来评价端到端布局丰富的一代。 MOSS-Image在LLTB上的开放量级模型中实现了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率为96.3%。在RALA方面，MOSS-Image在端对端系统比较中排名第二，而其骨干在使用共享增强提示器评价的发电机中排名第一。我们将发布模式、培训食谱和评价框架，以支持进一步研究，并促进文本到图像社区。

items.detail: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
items.title_zh: TTB：高效渲染解码器的测试时间
items.detail_zh: KV-cache的只解码器-大型视图合成模型(LVSMs)最近实现了最先进的质量，在不重建3D几何功能的情况下从神经网络中退后了新观点；而Test-Time Training(TTT)层则节省了计算而牺牲了质量。我们提出Test-Time Baking(TTB)，这个策略学习将全球场景信息从交叉视野的注意力烘焙成轻量级的MLP，使得快速而高纯度的小说-视野解码成为可能。第一个关键是重新使用TTT的快重MLP，从输入-输出对子中明确学习交叉视图注意力映射，而不是完全取代注意力，实现与TTT相同的渲染效率，同时交付质量大大提高。第二键处理上下文预填和小说视图渲染之间的模式错配：我们把上下文符号分解为仅相机上下文渲染符号作为TTB输入，而上下文地真相符号则使用图像内容作为TTB映射目标，确保被烘焙的MLP解除了上下文和小说视图处理之间的模式概括挑战。我们的方法可达到**23x** 使速度与若干基准的先进水平相当。项目网页：https://test-time-baking.github.io

items.detail: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy, SO-Arena assesses decision reliability through two complementary measures: decision stability under controlled option-set changes and missing-answer recognition when no valid option is available. Evaluations across 21 models reveal that the benefits of scaling and additional reasoning vary substantially across domains. More importantly, strong overall performance does not necessarily imply reliable decision-making: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability. Together, these findings highlight the need to characterize capability spectrum and decision reliability as complementary dimensions, providing a systematic view of the strengths and limitations of System One models.
items.title_zh: SO-Arena：系统1模型的能力光谱和可靠性基准
items.detail_zh: 系统 一种模式保证迅速作出通用决策，而不产生冗长的象征。然而，了解它们的能力范围和决策的可靠性，需要的不仅仅是目前基准的总体业绩。现有评价往往对模型能力的广度及其决定的可靠性提供有限见解。我们引入了SO-Arena，这是描述系统一模型在11个领域和5个能力家庭的能力范围和决策可靠性的基准。对于能力频谱，SO-Arena通过可靠来源提供循证评价，并对照可见模型输入对参考标签进行人工核查；通过特定域的困难标准进行精细的能力评估；以及现实的互动评价，其中模型迭代地在沙盒中执行行动。理性密集型任务进一步使系统能够进行一至二比较。除了准确性外，SO-Arena通过两种补充措施评估决定的可靠性：在可控选项设定变化下的决定稳定性和在没有有效选项时的答错识别。对21个模型的评价表明，规模化和额外推理的好处在各不同领域差别很大。更重要的是，强有力的总体业绩并不一定意味着可靠的决策：业绩最好的系统一模型在可靠性方面仅排名第七。这些结论共同突出表明，需要将能力频谱和决策可靠性定性为补充层面，系统地审视系统一模型的优点和局限性。

items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep：代理内存的时空知识图架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep，这是AI代理的新记忆层服务，在深记忆检索(DMR)基准中，它的表现超过了目前最先进的系统MemGPT。此外，Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优异，能够更好地反映现实世界的企业使用案例。虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理商的现有检索-增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索，但企业应用程序需要从不同来源，包括正在进行的对话和业务数据，进行动态知识整合。 Zep通过它的核心成分Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎，在保持历史关系的同时，动态地合成非结构的对话数据和结构化的商业数据。在作为主要评价指标的多指标类集调查小组制定的DMR基准中，Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。除了DMR，泽普的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准进一步验证，通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业的使用案例。在本次评价中，泽普取得了实质性成果，精度提高高达18.5%，同时与基线实施相比，反应延迟度降低了90%。这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出，显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果。

items.title: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning

items.detail: This work proposes WaveGen, a fully end-to-end diffusion-based text-to-waveform framework based on Spectral Forcing, which jointly learns an internal spectral trajectory and the target waveform trajectory within a single model, enabling direct end-to-end text-to-waveform generation. Unlike recent TTS pipelines, WaveGen does not rely on separately trained or externally decoded intermediate representations, such as neural audio codecs, Mel-spectrogram vocoders, or VAE-based latent models. In addition, WaveGen performs internal text-speech alignment within a single model, eliminating the need for external alignment modules such as duration predictors. To preserve a truly end-to-end formulation, our framework further avoids dependence on self-supervised representations, such as BERT-based text embeddings and Wav2Vec 2.0-based semantic representations, as well as semantic distillation methods for training optimization. To achieve this, we carefully design Spectral Forcing, a model architecture with disentangled diffusion heads, and a training objective based on a multi-scale spectral v-loss. We further validate the scalability of end-to-end TTS models by scaling the model size from 0.1B to 0.6B parameters. Using a single architecture, open-source data, and one-stage training, without external modules such as duration predictor or REPA, WaveGen demonstrates fully end-to-end waveform generation achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Emilia training dataset. In particular, WaveGen achieves a WER of 1.47 and a SIM of 0.75 on the Seed-en benchmark. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/sh-lee-prml/WaveGen
items.title_zh: WaveGen：通过内部光谱轨迹学习实现真正的端对端波形生成
items.detail_zh: 这部作品提出"波源"(WaveGen)，是一种基于Spectral Forcing的完全端到端扩散的文本到波阵框架，它在一个单一模型内共同学习了内部的光谱轨迹和目标波阵轨迹，使得直接的端到端的文本到波阵生成成为可能。与最近的TTS管道不同，WaveGen并不依赖单独训练或外部解码的中间表示，例如神经音频编码器，Mel-spectrogram vocoders，或基于VAE的潜伏模型。此外，WaveGen在一个单一模型内进行内部的文本语音对齐，从而不再需要持续时间预测器等外部对齐模块。为了保留真正的端到端的表达方式，我们的框架进一步避免了依赖自控表达方式，如基于BERT的文本嵌入和基于Wav2Vec 2.0的语义表达方式，以及用于培训优化的语义提炼方法。为了实现这一目标，我们精心设计了Spectral Forcing，一个具有分散散射头的模型架构，以及基于多尺度光谱v-损失的训练目标。我们进一步验证端对端TTS模型的可扩展性，将模型大小从0.1B缩放到0.6B参数。使用单一架构，开源数据和单阶段培训，没有持续时间预测器或REPA等外部模块，WaveGen在Emilia培训数据集上演示了完全的端到端波形生成，实现了最先进的性能。尤其是，WaveGen在种子-en基准上实现了1.47的WER和0.75的SIM。来源代码和检查站见https://github.com/sh-lee-prml/WaveGen。

items.detail: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
items.title_zh: SUPRA-TEX：带有超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
items.detail_zh: 单图像 3D 生成旨在将一个给定的 3D 网格以可燃材料着装，同时忠实地保存一个参考图像的视觉细节。现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入文物，要么通过隐含的图像特性条件来努力保存细微细节。为了应对这些挑战，我们采用了SUPRA-Tex，其基础是可视材料估算、表面对齐和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则。这种分工使得经过有限3D数据培训的3D生成器能够将其能力集中于保存可见证据和完成无法观察的表面。具体而言，我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型，在参考视图中预测照明分离的PBR地图。然后把这些地图投射到可见的表面 用预先训练过的材料 VAE编码器 编码成原生观测潜伏体 共享生成目标潜伏空间 间叶流变压器将这些潜伏物作为固定的、只读的锚，同时交替进行未观测区域和全表面更新，以产生完整的物质潜伏物。这个设计实现了与参考物的超调和，在可见区域上传递你所看到的是忠诚的事物，在看不见的表面上连贯完成。 SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训，在几何条件的纹理和端到端资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能，比对甚至超过了在闪烁的图像上领先的商业系统。项目网页：https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

items.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors

items.detail: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.
items.title_zh: Ropedia Xperience 2：放大物理AI环境和行为的黄金标准
items.detail_zh: 大型地基模型如GPT-6 Astra和克勞德·菲克 5.1最近被显示直接从视觉观测控制机器人。然而，在现实环境中，它们仍然在漫长的、富于接触的任务上步履维艰。进一步的进展取决于两个补充资源：监督如何执行任务的人类行为的展示，以及可以将政策推出、评价和在封闭的循环中加以改进的互动环境。语言模型沿着特征鲜明的缩放定律前进；物理AI的相应问题是如何在环境和行为上进行能力缩放，这首先需要确定哪些数据可以缩放，以及如何持续地生产和再利用这些数据。为了解决这个问题，我们介绍Ropedia Xperience 2，包括1,589个已发布的公尺平面3D扫描和4,230个自负式记录集，共74个任务(131小时)。我们进一步表明，每次捕获都可以被重新用于机器人学习：场景被转换为物理交互模拟环境，人类运动被重新瞄准全身机器人轨迹，通过虚拟远程操作和自动长相轨道生成获得更多的机器人行为。我们提议联合捕获环境和行为，作为物理AI数据收集的金本位标准，为制定超越环境和行为的法律奠定数据基础。

items.detail: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.
items.title_zh: JoVox：轻量级Voxel世代联合级流匹配
items.detail_zh: 在保持其轻量级的同时产生高纯度的阴道，仍然是计算机视觉中一个公开的问题。目前的发电机要么是高纯度的，要么是计算重量的，要么是重量较低的，但忠诚度较低。等级方法保持了阴道的轻量级性质。然而，它们的粗体水平决定了所有细细胞的出现地点，生成时关于形状的信息最少，并且从未再被重审，所以它们常常是可信但错误的。我们的关键洞察力是让细细胞参与决定粗细胞。为此，我们提出JoVox这个离散的流配比框架，它学习了各层次的Voxel阶梯的联合分布，而不是每个阶梯的单独分布，这样粗细的细胞就可以用附近已经产生的更细的细胞来预测。在这个框架内，我们进一步引入了两级预测，它一次输出两层细化细胞，而不是一层细化细胞，将网络处理的级别减半，产生更高忠诚度的阴道。我们还采用了一种解密战略，一旦产生更细的细胞，就重新审视早期的决定，并纠正蒙面扩散模型中的不一致之处。我们的框架在无条件和以图像为条件的阴道生成上都超过了基线。与目前最先进的TRELLIS.2相比，我们实现了8x更高的训练吞吐量，向前传的FLOP的1/15,4对32GPU的列车，并以11%的差差差获得更高的质量。

items.detail: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.
items.title_zh: WeVisOne-VL：从对象到像素的统一视觉感受
items.detail_zh: 现有的视觉语言模型(VLMs)对于精细的视觉感知仍然不可靠。在本报告中，我们介绍了WeVisOne-VL(WeChat Vision All-in-One)，这是一种强大的VLM，通过结构化的下个托肯预测，统一对象级和像素级的感知。它支持多个视觉任务，包括对象检测，转介本地化，计数，OCR，分区化，以及交配，使得任何用户特定颗粒的本地化，从点和盒到面具和α垫。在建筑上，我们通过一个特殊的<OBJ>令牌，将一个轻量级像素解码器整合到VLM中，以生成实例级像素输出。我们用三个阶段的课程来训练这个模型 SFT 然后是混合任务RL。在超过30个基准中，WeVisOne-VL在对象级别和像素级别的任务中都表现出领先性能，同时对对象偏差查询保持强烈拒绝。通过将WeVisOne-VL释放给开源社区，我们希望将VLM从广义的视觉理解推进到真正可靠的感知系统，用于现实世界的部署。

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
items.subtitle: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的，产生一弹一弹，或者通过松散控制的自译自审来演化，其中没有任何一种表现得像技能的深层学习优化器，没有任何一种在反馈下可靠地改善了它的起点。我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外部状态来训练，具有同样的学科，使得重量空间优化可以再生产。据我们所知，SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器：一个单独的优化器模型将打分的推出转换成在单一技能文档上绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑，只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才接受编辑。文本学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定，同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)中，SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、带)捆绑在一起的，并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一击LM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。在GPT-5.5上，它通过直接聊天的+23.5分，Codex代理循环的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度。转移实验进一步显示，优化的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时，在Codex和Claude代码执行环境之间，以及在不进一步优化的情况下，保留到附近的数学基准上的价值。

items.title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
items.subtitle: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). items.detail: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing. Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.
items.title_zh: 小米-OCR-0技术报告
items.detail_zh: 紧凑的OCR特有视觉语言模型实现了强大的文档解析性能，但往往依赖于昂贵的监督并主要专注于视觉文字重建。我们引入了Xiaomi-OCR-0，一个统一的0.8B模型，用于文档解析和OCR-中心理解。我们利用一个自动化数据引擎，将专家的共识、基于渲染的核查和有针对性的综合结合起来，建立一个大约170M-样本OCR中心体。从Qwen3.5-0.8B开始，我们的渐进式训练菜谱结合了以Q-mask为基础的文本主锚，持续预训，以及混合任务强化学习(Mix-RL)。小米-OCR-0在Real5-OmniDoc Bench上实现了95.24分，在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.83分，在Wild-OmniDoc Bench上实现了87.94分，同时在面向OCR的VQA5个基准上达到了83.2分的平均分。拨款情况进一步表明，经过充分的解析培训，以OCR为中心的理解监督为文件解析提供了额外的收益。主页：https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/小米-OCR-0。

items.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure

items.detail: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to 2.75times and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from 17.4% to 30.0%, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.
items.title_zh: FRARSI：利用自我改进培训基础设施
items.detail_zh: 虽然递归自我改进(RSI)加速了孤立的算法和内核合成，但分布式LLM训练依赖于紧密结合的发射设置，操作员内核，以及通信时间表，其中单项编辑经常击中出模(OOM)边界，编译器冲突，测量紧张，或无声的数字漂移。我们介绍了InfraRSI，即通过五阶段工作流程将开放的人类命令转化为可核查的训练优化的代理工具：将可编辑范围与固定任务合同锁定在工作量、损失和时间变化方面，以防止奖励黑客、医生剖面基线阶段和校准集群噪音，在对照基线和记录结果对顶级候选人进行重新验证之前，对顶级候选人进行协同优化，并进行跨硬件经验库的核查，报告和应用审计来源路径，跟踪审判失败的费用，并进行推动变革。 InfraRSI不是贪婪地从一个任职者身上跳出，而是从各种经验种子的配置中开始，适合全球执行时间，并审查包括OOMs在内的所有审判的高峰记忆模式。使用这些模型，它定价每设定内存成本，从直播运行中修改错误的LLM前缀，并与内存保存器和经核实的代码补丁对内存-饥饿优化。在四个单节和多节点密集和混合专家(MOE)LLM工作量中，InfraRSI实现了最高2.75次的速度，并提升了FLOPs模型利用(MFU)从17.4%到30.0%，在跨GPU传输经验的同时，优于现有调音器和编码代理。随着培训基础设施效率的提高，InfraRSI形成了一个双层递归性自我改进循环——在运行内部在线重审前科，并在集群间提炼经验——以推推基础模型缩放。

items.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
items.subtitle: Language barriers in scientific documents hinder the diffusion and development of science and technologies. However, prior efforts in translating such documents largely overlooked the information in layouts. To bridge the gap, we introduce PDFMathTranslate, the world's first open-source software for translating scientific documents while preserving layouts. Leveraging the most recent advances in large language models and precise layout detection, we contribute to the community with key improvements in precision, flexibility, and efficiency. The work has been open-sourced at https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate with more than 222k downloads.

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction vi
items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. We describe the artifact contract, generation workflow, correction lifecycle, deployment surface, and domain presets implemented in the open-source system. At the time of writing, the public repository has approximately 18.5k GitHub stars; the gallery lists 215 skills from 165 contributors and more than 100k cumulative stars across listed skill cards. The system illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.
items.title_zh: COLLEAGUE.SKILLL：通过专家知识扭曲实现自动AI技能生成
items.detail_zh: 人们日益期望LLM代理人不仅完成孤立的任务，而且还要承担人的专门知识、判断和互动风格的有限表述。建立这种以人为基础的代理人仍然很困难，因为与一个人或角色有关的可操作的知识通常嵌入各种痕迹，而不是写成干净的指示。现有的内存和人名系统收集这些证据的碎片，而技能框架则提供便携式包装格式；然而，没有从端到端的工作流程将这些痕迹分馏成可检查、可纠正和可用剂的技能。我们提出一个自动追踪技能蒸馏系统，通过专家知识蒸馏产生个人的人工智能技能。由于来自目标人或角色的材料，COLLEAGUE.SKILL制作了一个版本技能包，有两条协调的音轨：练习能力音轨，心理模型和决定heuristics，以及交流风格，互动规则，以及校正历史的限定行为音轨。该套件可以检查，引用，通过自然语言反馈更新，回滚，跨代理主机安装，并可选择为控制发行做准备。我们描述了在开源系统中实施的文物合同、生成工作流程、修正生命周期、部署表面和域预设。在写作时，公共寄存器大约有18.5k GitHub星；画廊列出了165名贡献者的215个技能，以及超过100k的累计恒星横跨列表技能卡。该系统说明个人定位技能如何能够被表现为便携式，可纠正的包，而不是不透明的提示或隐藏的记忆。

items.detail: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
items.title_zh: REMORY：学习残余内存用于背景缩合
items.detail_zh: 长视线代理人将自己的历史压缩在一个有限的上下文窗口中继续，但单是文字摘要可能不能支持以后的每一项决定。我们介绍REMORY，一个神经记忆网络，以软记忆符号的限定序列来补充摘要。鉴于历史和摘要，该网络学会生成一些符号，帮助冻结的LLM大致显示它将产生的完整历史的延续。符号以摘要为条件，并附在其之后，沿序列维形成一个剩余连接的类似物。在SummHay上，REMORY在近乎不变的洞察力覆盖下改进了源属性，并使用5.2%的输入位置接近全文联合得分。纵观长视剂基准，Qune3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash在剩余内存方面显示出一致的收益。两种模型在浏览器Comp和终端-Bench 2.1上显示的重复工具输出和工具错误也大大减少。

items.detail: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from a rigged 3D asset and a text prompt, with no test-time optimization or per-skeleton retraining. UniMate introduces a topology-aware diffusion transformer, which integrates skeletal topology into attention via three mechanisms: (1) a graph-aware attention bias from pairwise joint relations and geodesic distances; (2) a spectral rotary position embedding generalizing RoPE to arbitrary kinematic trees via the graph Laplacian; and (3) a global topological conditioner attention-pooled from the rest-pose skeleton. We also curate UniML3D, 13,006 motion sequences spanning bipedal, quadrupedal, avian, marine, insectoid, serpentine, and articulated rigid objects with unified canonicalization and text pairing. Trained on this dataset, UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, and supports zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing. Our project page is available at https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/.
items.title_zh: UniMate：将千变万化的 Skeletons 动画统一模型
items.detail_zh: 近期在自动操纵方面的进步现在可以大规模地提供动画准备的3D资产，但驱动这些资产的运动仍然是一个瓶颈。现有学习的动画师在地形学上是受制约的：他们依赖特定类别的模板，或者要求每斯凯莱顿在推论时进行微调和参考运动。我们提出UniMate，一个统一的基础模型，它从一个被操纵的3D资产和文本提示器中合成任意骨架的清晰运动，没有测试时间优化或每斯凯莱顿再培训。 UniMate引入了一种地形感知扩散变压器，通过三种机制将骨骼感知融合到注意力中：(1)对偶联关系和大地测量距离的图感知注意力偏差；(2)通过图Laplacian嵌入RoPE的光谱回转位置，将RoPE通化到任意运动树上；(3)从休眠骨架上汇集全球地形感知器注意力。我们还管理UniML3D、13 006个运动序列，这些序列跨越两面体、四面体、禽类、海洋、昆虫、蛇形动物和具有统一条形化和文本配对的刚性物体。受此数据集训练，UniMate在质量，通俗化，效率方面超越了最先进的基线，支持零镜头跨地形传输，介于间隙，扩展，以及文本引导编辑。我们的项目网页见https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/。

items.detail: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points. To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.
items.title_zh: LLM 培训后删除重量的惊人效果
items.detail_zh: 预先训练的大型语言模型(LLM)要改变多少才能获得新的能力？我们发现，零到0.05%的权重，没有其它修改，与三个LLM培训后体系的全微调(FFT)规模匹配：强化学习，提供可核查的奖励，监督微调，以及政策上提炼。我们的方法Delettion Tuning在变压器块的门投影上学习了二进制口罩。接下来有两个实际的优点：训练有素的口罩比相应的FFT检查站小上上百到上千倍，而Deletion Tuning的忘却则少得多，这解决了持续学习中的一个中心挑战。在加固学习下，其前置任务精度会保持在基位附近，而FFT，LORA，和随机零星的微调则会损失高达5.4分。为了理解为什么光是遮掩就足够了，我们用稳定的分级，光谱漂移，和主重相重叠来分析在强化学习下所学到的重量变化的几何。与LORA和随机稀疏的微调相比，Delettion Tuning最接近于FFT，跨越了这三项度量。

items.detail: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how evidence is located and exposed; and the Budgeted Read Gate bounds cumulative raw exposure per episode with faithful full-view fallback. A unified Reader interface supports interchangeable evidence acquisition across heterogeneous resources. Across six models, including Claude Opus 5, and five scenarios, SparseRead reduces total tokens by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, preserving or improving task quality in 97% settings. On Web deep-search tasks, it reduces tokens by 31.0--43.0% and task completion time by 23.0--37.0%. Ablations validate the three designs, while integration with three agent frameworks demonstrates portability.
items.detail_zh: 网易AI代理多次访问网页，文档，寄存器和工具响应，然而读取界面往往会在仅需要稀有证据时暴露出整个对象。这种过度阅读会增加象征性和耐用性的成本，并会淡化相关证据。我们介绍SparseRead，一个可重复使用的读取控制层，它规范内容录入而不修改代理模型。其"读入"(Read Intent Protocol)跟踪不断变化的需要和源覆盖；"适应"(Adaptive Reader Backends)选择证据的定位和曝光方式；"预算"(Read Gate)将每集的累积原始曝光与忠实的"全景回放"相接。统一的Reader接口支持在各种资源之间交换证据。包括克洛德·奥普斯5和5种情景在内的6种模型中，SparseRead将总的代币减少高达92.9%，墙壁时间减少高达89.0%，在97%的环境下保留或提高任务质量。在Web深度搜索任务上，它将令牌减少31.0-43.0%，任务完成时间减少23.0-37.0%。与三个代理框架的结合表明可移植性。

items.detail: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍PhysioWave-T，一个标致高效的波浪基底家族， EEG， ECG，和sEMG。动态缩放折叠后将J+1波段子带重接后再进行标定化，将序列长度从(J+1)CS压缩到J级的CS令牌，C通道和S时段补丁。特定路由的前端和已学会的频道名嵌入使每个模式有一个变形器可以处理不同的相通和采样率，而看不见的设置则通过轻量级适配器来再利用主干。我们在超过15M窗口(19-128个通道)上预训了30M参数的EEG模型，与ECG(30M)和sEMG(12M)编码器并列。跨越四个 EEG 路线，规模折叠切变形器长生能为 4.0-7.2x，峰值内存为 6.8-12.7x 超规模扩展而无精度损失。我们的EEG编码器对BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT的9个度量中，领先8个，可靠性-知性潜在聚变(RALF)通过取自样品-可调取的权重，进一步将来自独立预训编码器的汇总符号整合起来。在SeizeIT2上，RALF在11个假警报时将事件敏感性从61.4%提高到74.4%，窗口AUPRC从0.321提高到0.399，超过了最佳单式基线，超过了加权记录和所有变体的通配。 PhysioWave-T还实现了PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上最先进的SEMG快取和顶级宏F1。代码和型号：https://github.com/Forever Blue816/PhysioWave。

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且在优化期间优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据再加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的以数据为中心的统一动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域相混合调整，和样本再加权，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全相容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够被滴入替换，并统一了嵌入取取出，推论，梯度计算等关键依赖模型的操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行综合实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU的静态全数据培训上都一直超过业绩。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上以6B和30B符号标尺预先训练Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM既能提高MMLU的准确度，又能提高实体水平的复杂度，使其高于默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的一致运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: We introduce KAPSO, a modular framework for autonomous program synthesis and optimization. Given a natural language goal and an evaluation method, KAPSO iteratively performs ideation, code synthesis and editing, execution, evaluation, and learning to improve a runnable artifact toward measurable objectives. Rather than treating synthesis as the endpoint, KAPSO uses synthesis as an operator within a long-horizon optimization loop, where progress is defined by evaluator outcomes. KAPSO targets long-horizon failures common in coding agents, including lost experimental state, brittle debugging, and weak reuse of domain expertise, by integrating three tightly coupled components. First, a git-native experimentation engine isolates each attempt as a branch, producing reproducible artifacts and preserving provenance across iterations. Second, a knowledge system ingests heterogeneous sources, including repositories, internal playbooks, and curated external resources such as documentation, scientific papers, and web search results, and organizes them into a structured representation that supports retrieval over workflows, implementations, and environment constraints. Third, a cognitive memory layer coordinates retrieval and maintains an episodic store of reusable lessons distilled from experiment traces (run logs, diffs, and evaluator feedback), reducing repeated error modes and accelerating convergence. We evaluated KAPSO on MLE-Bench (Kaggle-style ML competitions) and ALE-Bench (AtCoder heuristic optimization), and report end-to-end performance. Code Available at: https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso
items.title_zh: KAPSO：自主方案综合和优化知识框架
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了KAPSO，一个用于自主程序合成和优化的模块化框架。鉴于自然语言目标和一种评价方法，KAPSO迭代地进行思想、代码合成和编辑、执行、评价和学习，以改善可操作的文物，以达到可衡量的目标。 KAPSO没有将合成作为终点，而是将合成作为长视最优化循环中的操作器，其中由评价结果来定义进度。 KAPSO通过整合三个紧密结合的组件，针对编码剂常见的长视距故障，包括丢失的实验状态，Brittle调试，以及薄弱的域专业知识再利用。首先，一个基特-内生实验引擎将每次尝试隔离为分支，生产出可再生的文物并在整个迭代中保存出处。第二，一个知识系统吸收各种来源，包括储存库、内部游戏本以及文献、科学论文和网络搜索结果等整理的外部资源，并将其组织成结构化的表述，支持在工作流程、执行和环境限制方面进行检索。第三，认知记忆层协调检索，并维持从实验痕迹(运行日志、diffs和评估反馈)中提取的可再利用的教训的零星存储，减少重复出错模式并加速趋同。我们在MLE-Bench(Kaggle-style ML竞赛)和ALE-Bench(AtCoder Heuristic 优化)上评价了KAPSO，并报告了端到端的性能。代码见：https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.detail: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted to downstream tasks via reinforcement learning (RL) methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which often require thousands of rollouts to learn new tasks. We argue that the interpretable nature of language can often provide a much richer learning medium for LLMs, compared with policy gradients derived from sparse, scalar rewards. To test this, we introduce GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), a prompt optimizer that thoroughly incorporates natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error. Given any AI system containing one or more LLM prompts, GEPA samples system-level trajectories (e.g., reasoning, tool calls, and tool outputs) and reflects on them in natural language to diagnose problems, propose and test prompt updates, and combine complementary lessons from the Pareto frontier of its own attempts. As a result of GEPA's design, it can often turn even just a few rollouts into a large quality gain. Across four tasks, GEPA outperforms GRPO by 10% on average and by up to 20%, while using up to 35x fewer rollouts. GEPA also outperforms the leading prompt optimizer, MIPROv2, by over 10% across two LLMs, and demonstrates promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.

items.detail: Real-time video editing requires low-latency causal generation with bounded computational resources while preserving source fidelity and long-term temporal consistency. We present JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B-parameter autoregressive diffusion framework for real-time, open-ended video editing without access to future frames or a predefined video duration. Our method combines chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation, Source-Anchored Distribution Matching Distillation (SA-DMD), and Long-Horizon Autoregressive Distillation to reduce train--inference mismatch, preserve source fidelity during two-step generation, and mitigate accumulated temporal drift. Extensive automatic and human evaluations show that JoyAI-Video-Edit substantially outperforms existing streaming editors and remains competitive with strong offline systems on both short and long videos. The complete system achieves end-to-end 720p video editing at approximately 30 FPS on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Video-Edit.
items.title_zh: JoyAI-Video-Edit：实时开放式视频编辑，并带有自旋扩散功能
items.detail_zh: 实时视频编辑需要低相关性的因果生成，同时使用受限的计算资源，同时保持源的忠诚和长期的时间一致性。我们介绍JoyAI-Video-Edit，这是一个16B参数的自递式传播框架，用于实时、开放式的视频编辑，没有未来帧或预先确定的视频持续时间。我们的方法结合了分块自旋回向适应，Source-Anchored Discription(SA-DMD)和Long-Horizon自旋回向回向回向回向回向回向，以减少列车-推论不匹配，在两步相传期间保持源的忠诚，并减少累积的时间漂移。广泛的自动和人文评价显示，JoyAI-Video-Edit大大超过现有的流媒体编辑，在短视频和长视频上仍然具有强大的离线系统竞争力。完整的系统在单Nvidia B200 GPU上以约30个FPS实现端到端的720p视频编辑。代码见https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Video-Edit。

items.detail: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, The Harness of Harnesses, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an All-Domain Collaboration Network, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Raven：利用哈内斯为可编译的代理智能
items.detail_zh: 随着大型语言模型的推进，AI代理正在超越孤立的，专有域的任务，转向长视野，跨域工作流程。这一过渡暴露了两个挑战：日益复杂的利用使得人工设计难以规模化，而与具体领域的更紧密的结合限制了单一的利用的通用性。因此，中心问题从如何为一个领域设计更强大的工具转向如何自主地建造专门工具，通过经验改进这些工具，并在各个领域加以协调。我们引入了Raven， The Harnesses，一个开源的多剂生态系统，它自动构建和演化特定模型和域的模块化带，将每个可执行的模型-harness配对作为可调和的智能单元。为了支持一个全域协作网络，其主机代理会分解目标，将子任务匹配到专门代理，协调执行依赖，并整合结果，而主机档案和EverOS则保存跨任务的经验，Skill Forge使该经验成为可重复使用的程序。我们的理论为这种构成提供了充分的条件，以扩大可靠的任务范围，使其超出共享资源预算下现有个别代理人的任务范围。在复杂而长的视野任务上，雷文显著地超越了最先进的特工系统，推动了可复合的特工智能的前沿。

items.detail: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. The inference engine is production-ready for streaming, achieving an RTF of 0.195 and a time-to-first-audio below 100 ms.Our code and weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to try custom voices.

items.title: Trading-R1: Financial Trading with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.subtitle: Developing professional, structured reasoning on par with human financial analysts and traders remains a central challenge in AI for finance, where markets demand interpretability and trust. Traditional time-series models lack explainability, while LLMs face challenges in turning natural-language analysis into disciplined, executable trades. Although reasoning LLMs have advanced in step-by-step planning and verification, their application to risk-sensitive financial decisions is underexplored. We present Trading-R1, a financially-aware model that incorporates strategic thinking and planning for comprehensive thesis composition, facts-grounded analysis, and volatility-adjusted decision making
items.detail: Developing professional, structured reasoning on par with human financial analysts and traders remains a central challenge in AI for finance, where markets demand interpretability and trust. Traditional time-series models lack explainability, while LLMs face challenges in turning natural-language analysis into disciplined, executable trades. Although reasoning LLMs have advanced in step-by-step planning and verification, their application to risk-sensitive financial decisions is underexplored. We present Trading-R1, a financially-aware model that incorporates strategic thinking and planning for comprehensive thesis composition, facts-grounded analysis, and volatility-adjusted decision making. Trading-R1 aligns reasoning with trading principles through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with a three-stage easy-to-hard curriculum. Training uses Tauric-TR1-DB, a 100k-sample corpus spanning 18 months, 14 equities, and five heterogeneous financial data sources. Evaluated on six major equities and ETFs, Trading-R1 demonstrates improved risk-adjusted returns and lower drawdowns compared to both open-source and proprietary instruction-following models as well as reasoning models. The system generates structured, evidence-based investment theses that support disciplined and interpretable trading decisions. Trading-R1 Terminal will be released at https://github.com/TauricResearch/Trading-R1.
items.title_zh: 贸易-R1：通过强化学习实现与LLM的金融交易
items.detail_zh: 发展与人力金融分析师和贸易商同等的专业、结构化推理，仍然是AI在金融方面的中心挑战，因为市场需要解释性和信任。传统的时序模型缺乏可解释性，而LLMS则面临着将自然语言分析转化为有纪律的，可执行的贸易的挑战。虽然有限责任公司在逐步规划和核实方面取得了进步，但它们在对风险敏感的财务决定中的应用不足。我们提出贸易-R1，这是一种财务意识模式，它包含战略思维和规划，以综合理论构成、事实分析以及波动调整决策。 Trading-R1通过有监督的微调和强化学习使推理与贸易原则相一致，采用三级易硬课程。培训使用Tauric-TR1-DB，这是一个100千个样本，涵盖18个月、14个股票和5个不同的财务数据来源。在对六大股票和ETF进行评价后，Trading-R1显示，与开源和专有指导模式以及推理模式相比，风险调整后的回报率有所改进，提款率较低。该系统产生结构化的循证投资，支持有纪律和可解释的贸易决定。贸易-R1终端将在https://github.com/TauricResearch/Trading-R1上发布。

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.title: Bitnet.cpp: Efficient Edge Inference for Ternary LLMs
items.subtitle: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs), led by BitNet b1.58, has spurred interest in ternary LLMs. Despite this, research and practical applications focusing on efficient edge inference for ternary LLMs remain scarce. items.detail: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs), led by BitNet b1.58, has spurred interest in ternary LLMs. Despite this, research and practical applications focusing on efficient edge inference for ternary LLMs remain scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce Bitnet.cpp, an inference system optimized for BitNet b1.58 and ternary LLMs. Given that mixed-precision matrix multiplication (mpGEMM) constitutes the bulk of inference time in ternary LLMs, Bitnet.cpp incorporates a novel mpGEMM library to facilitate sub-2-bits-per-weight, efficient and lossless inference. The library features two core solutions: Ternary Lookup Table (TL), which addresses spatial inefficiencies of previous bit-wise methods, and Int2 with a Scale (I2_S), which ensures lossless edge inference, both enabling high-speed inference. Our experiments show that Bitnet.cpp achieves up to a 6.25x increase in speed over full-precision baselines and up to 2.32x over low-bit baselines, setting new benchmarks in the field. Additionally, we expand TL to element-wise lookup table (ELUT) for low-bit LLMs in the appendix, presenting both theoretical and empirical evidence of its considerable potential. Bitnet.cpp is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper , offering a sophisticated solution for the efficient and practical deployment of edge LLMs.
items.title_zh: Bitnet.cpp：特尔纳里LLMs的高效边缘推论
items.detail_zh: 由 BitNet b1.58 牵头的1位大语言模型(LLM)的出现，激发了对ternary LLMs的兴趣。尽管如此，侧重于三边法学硕士的有效边缘推论的研究和实际应用仍然很少。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Bitnet.cpp，一个为BitNet b1.58和ternary LLMs优化的推论系统。鉴于混合精度矩阵乘法(mpGEMM)构成Ternary LLMs的大部分推论时间， Bitnet.cpp 包含了一款新的 mpGEMM 库来方便子-2位/人/人/人/人/人的推论。该库有两个核心解决方案：Trinary Lookup Table(TL)，它解决了以前位取方法的空间效率低下问题；和I2 S的Int2，它确保了无损失的边缘推论，两者都有利于高速推论。我们的实验显示，Bitnet.cpp比全精度基线达到6.25x增速，比低位基线达到2.32x增速，为球场设定了新的基准。此外，我们还将TL扩展为附录中低位 LLMs 的元素取向表(ELUT)，提出了其巨大潜力的理论和经验证据。 Bitnet.cpp可在https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper上公开查阅，为有效实际部署边缘有限责任公司提供了一个复杂的解决方案。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.
items.title_zh: Solv3R：三维循环变换器作为多视图解析器
items.detail_zh: 古典结构 - 从运动重建 反复进行，精炼相机姿势和场景几何 从目前的估计。这样可以方便地扩展地图，而无需重新计算已经计算的视图，或者随着提供更多的观测结果而改进几何估计。然而，大多数几何地基模型都预测整个几何在一次前行传中，或者随着帧相继到达而更新了常态，使得这种扩展和精炼非三角。我们引入了Solv3R，一种循环变速器，它学习继续从当前状态解决多视图几何问题。重要的是，其更新操作员独立于重复计数，可以让先前经过改进和新提出的观点共同更新，而不论其“解决”的程度如何。我们训练操作人员在不断重复和纠正不准确状态下保存准确的重建，从而能够完善固定图像收集并整合新的观测结果。对已解开的视图的表示也可被缓存一次并重复使用，作为跨迭代的几何上下文，从而能够进行紧凑而高效的密钥值缓存。我们分析解析器动态，并将其与最先进的解析器进行比较，表明一个单一的有学识的解析器支持离线重建，增量重建，再定位，并流出而不进行特定任务的培训或模块。守则和模型将在https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/上公布。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.detail: Deploying deep learning models on mobile devices draws more and more attention recently. However, designing an efficient inference engine on devices is under the great challenges of model compatibility, device diversity, and resource limitation. To deal with these challenges, we propose Mobile Neural Network (MNN), a universal and efficient inference engine tailored to mobile applications. In this paper, the contributions of MNN include: (1) presenting a mechanism called pre-inference that manages to conduct runtime optimization; (2)deliveringthorough kernel optimization on operators to achieve optimal computation performance; (3) introducing backend abstraction module which enables hybrid scheduling and keeps the engine lightweight. Extensive benchmark experiments demonstrate that MNN performs favorably against other popular lightweight deep learning frameworks. MNN is available to public at: https://github.com/alibaba/MNN.
items.title_zh: 通用高效推论引擎
items.detail_zh: 最近，在移动设备上部署深入的学习模式，引起了越来越多的关注。然而，设计一个有效的设备推论引擎面临模型兼容性、设备多样性和资源限制的巨大挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议移动神经网络(MNN)，这是一个适合移动应用的通用高效推论引擎。在本文中，MNN的贡献包括：(1) 提出一种称为前推论的机制，以管理运行时间优化；(2) 向操作员交付内核优化，以达到最佳计算性能；(3) 引入后端抽象模块，使混合调度得以进行，使引擎保持轻量级。广泛的基准实验表明，MNN优于其他流行的轻量级深层学习框架。 MNN向公众开放，网址是：https://github.com/alibaba/MNN。

items.detail: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code
items.title_zh: 视频编码器：加强视频生成代理编码
items.detail_zh: 近年来，录像制作在视觉质量和时间一致性方面都取得了显著进展。然而，制作具有精确空间结构的视频、连贯的运动动态和可控制的场景组成仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们引入了Video-Coder，这是培训由代码驱动的视频生成代理的首次尝试，它自主地编写和执行代码来构建动态3D场景(Draft Video)，为下游视频发电机提供结构和运动信号。为支持这一范式，我们设计了一个专用数据管道，并管理两个高质量的数据集，即Video-Coder-SFT-6k和Video-Coder-RL-2k，其中包含各种提示和地面实况参考视频。我们进一步发展Video-Coder Harness，将代码执行， 3D场景渲染，以及执行反馈整合为代理培训和推论。然后我们用SFT fol来训练视频编码器 低调的利用本地代理强化学习 并有双重的奖励反馈 两者结合的是执行和视频奖励 此外，我们设计了一种反射式训练战略，逐渐减少执行奖励，使该模式在后期训练阶段能够更多地依靠视频奖励。实验显示Video-Coder取得了显著的收获，在PhyGen Bench上改进了Minimax-H3，在V Bench-2.0上改进了约7分。我们希望这项工作能成为视频生成中编码代理的开放基础，我们完全开放数据，模型和代码的来源。
