items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential as autonomous agents, approaching human-expert performance through advanced reasoning and tool orchestration. However, decision-making in fully dynamic and live environments remains highly challenging, requiring real-time information integration and adaptive responses. While existing efforts have explored live evaluation mechanisms in structured tasks, a critical gap remains in systematic benchmarking for real-world applications, particularly in finance where stringent requirements exist for live strategic responsiveness. To address this gap, we introduce AI-Trader, the first fully-automated, live, and data-uncontaminated evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in financial decision-making. AI-Trader spans three major financial markets: U.S. stocks, A-shares, and cryptocurrencies, with multiple trading granularities to simulate live financial environments. Our benchmark implements a revolutionary fully autonomous minimal information paradigm where agents receive only essential context and must independently search, verify, and synthesize live market information without human intervention. We evaluate six mainstream LLMs across three markets and multiple trading frequencies. Our analysis reveals striking findings: general intelligence does not automatically translate to effective trading capability, with most agents exhibiting poor returns and weak risk management. We demonstrate that risk control capability determines cross-market robustness, and that AI trading strategies achieve excess returns more readily in highly liquid markets than policy-driven environments. These findings expose critical limitations in current autonomous agents and provide clear directions for future improvements. The code and evaluation data are open-sourced to foster community research: https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader.
items.title_zh: AI-Trader：实时金融市场自主代理基准
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出了作为自主代理的显著潜力，通过先进的推理和工具编组来接近人类专家的性能。然而，在充满活力的现场环境中作出决策仍然极具挑战性，需要实时信息整合和适应性对策。虽然现有努力在结构化任务中探索了现场评价机制，但在对现实世界的应用进行系统衡量方面仍存在重大差距，特别是在资金方面，因为对于现场战略反应能力有严格的要求。为了弥补这一差距，我们采用了AI-Trader，这是财务决策中第一个完全自动化、实时和数据未受污染的LLM剂评价基准。 AI-Trader跨越三大金融市场：美国股票，A股，和密码，有多个交易颗粒以模拟活的金融环境。我们的基准执行一种革命性、完全自主的最低限度信息范式，即代理人只接受基本环境，必须独立搜索、核实和综合市场实况信息，而无需人类干预。我们评估了三个市场和多个交易频率的六个主流有限责任公司。我们的分析揭示了引人注目的结论：一般情报不会自动转化为有效的贸易能力，大多数代理人的回报率低，风险管理薄弱。我们表明，风险控制能力决定了跨市场的稳健性，AI贸易战略比政策驱动的环境更容易在高流动性市场上实现过度回报。这些调查结果暴露了目前自主代理机构的关键局限性，为今后的改进提供了明确的方向。代码和评价数据开源，以促进社区研究：https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an essential infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet their lack of well-defined memory management systems hinders the development of long-context reasoning, continual personalization, and knowledge consistency.Existing models mainly rely on static parameters and short-lived contextual states, limiting their ability to track user preferences or update knowledge over extended periods.While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces external knowledge in plain text, it remains a stateless workaround without lifecycle control or integration with persistent representations.Recent work has modeled the training and inference cost of LLMs from a memory hierarchy perspective, showing that introducing an explicit memory layer between parameter memory and external retrieval can substantially reduce these costs by externalizing specific knowledge. Beyond computational efficiency, LLMs face broader challenges arising from how information is distributed over time and context, requiring systems capable of managing heterogeneous knowledge spanning different temporal scales and sources. To address this challenge, we propose MemOS, a memory operating system that treats memory as a manageable system resource. It unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories, enabling cost-efficient storage and retrieval. As the basic unit, a MemCube encapsulates both memory content and metadata such as provenance and versioning. MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, enabling flexible transitions between memory types and bridging retrieval with parameter-based learning. MemOS establishes a memory-centric system framework that brings controllability, plasticity, and evolvability to LLMs, laying the foundation for continual learning and personalized modeling.
items.title_zh: MemOS：AI系统的内存OS
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为人工一般智能(AGI)的基本基础设施，然而它们缺乏定义明确的内存管理系统，阻碍了长语推理，持续的个性化和知识一致性的发展。现有的模型主要依靠静态参数和短寿命的上下文状态，限制了它们在长时间内跟踪用户偏好或更新知识的能力。虽然检索-增强的一代(RAG)以简洁的文字介绍外部知识，但它仍然是无国籍的工作，没有生命周期控制或与持续表述相结合。最近的工作从内存结构的角度模拟了LLMs的培训和推论成本，表明在参数内存和外部检索之间引入一个明确的内存层，通过将特定知识外部化，可以大大减少这些成本。除了计算效率之外，法学硕士课程还面临着因信息如何在时间和背景上分布而带来的更广泛的挑战，需要能够管理跨越不同时间尺度和来源的各种知识的系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出MemOS，一种将内存视为可管理系统资源的内存操作系统。它统一了纯文本、基于激活的记忆和参数级记忆的表达、时间安排和演变，从而能够以具有成本效益的方式储存和检索。作为基本单元，一个MemCube同时封装内存内容和元数据，如出处和版本。元立方体可以随时间而组成，迁移，并熔化，使内存类型之间能够灵活过渡，并与基于参数的学习连接检索。 MemOS建立了一个以记忆为中心的系统框架，为LLMS带来可控性，可塑性和可转性，为持续学习和个性化建模奠定了基础。

items.detail: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.
items.detail_zh: 将印刷电路板(PCB)的路由自动化，需要在严格的设计规则下，通过几何执行来协调板层连接决定。虽然最近的代理商可以与本地的路由工具互动，但复杂板上可靠的路由仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍PCB Route Agent，这是一种多模式的PCB路由剂，灵感来源于人类工程师如何协调全球战略与本地执行。一个全球跑道规划师将板面图像和结构化的电气和几何信息结合起来，以指定连接地貌、线路顺序、走廊和地层过渡。详细路由执行器通过KiCad的本土路由引擎实现这些向导，并进行有界限的局部恢复。尚未解决的故障作为结构化反馈返回，从而能够进行有针对性的指南修订，同时保留公认的路径。我们通过四次PCBWorld-Bench测试对247个合成和现实世界的板块进行PCBRouteAgent的评价。它在D2，D3-A，D3-B和D3-C分别实现了100%，94.9%，100%和40%的清洁通行率。在三个现实世界子集中，PCB Route Agent的绩效分别比评估得最好的清洁通道率基准高出13.9分，36分和10分。

items.detail: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

items.detail: The rapidly growing demand for high-quality data in Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for scalable, reliable, and semantically rich data preparation pipelines. However, current practices remain dominated by ad-hoc scripts and loosely specified workflows, which lack principled abstractions, hinder reproducibility, and offer limited support for model-in-the-loop data generation. To address these challenges, we present DataFlow, a unified and extensible LLM-driven data preparation framework. DataFlow is designed with system-level abstractions that enable modular, reusable, and composable data transformations, and provides a PyTorch-style pipeline construction API for building debuggable and optimizable dataflows. The framework consists of nearly 200 reusable operators and six domain-general pipelines spanning text, mathematical reasoning, code, Text-to-SQL, agentic RAG, and large-scale knowledge extraction. To further improve usability, we introduce DataFlow-Agent, which automatically translates natural-language specifications into executable pipelines via operator synthesis, pipeline planning, and iterative verification. Across six representative use cases, DataFlow consistently improves downstream LLM performance. Our math, code, and text pipelines outperform curated human datasets and specialized synthetic baselines, achieving up to +3\% execution accuracy in Text-to-SQL over SynSQL, +7\% average improvements on code benchmarks, and 1--3 point gains on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. Moreover, a unified 10K-sample dataset produced by DataFlow enables base models to surpass counterparts trained on 1M Infinity-Instruct data. These results demonstrate that DataFlow provides a practical and high-performance substrate for reliable, reproducible, and scalable LLM data preparation, and establishes a system-level foundation for future data-centric AI development.
items.title_zh: 数据流：数据-Centric AI时代统一数据编制和工作流程自动化的LLM-Driven框架
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)对高质量数据的需求迅速增长，因此更加需要可扩展、可靠和精密的数据编制管道。然而，目前的做法仍然以临时的脚本和松散的指定的工作流程为主，这些工作流程缺乏原则性抽象，阻碍复制，为模拟即时数据生成提供了有限的支持。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“DataFlow”，一个统一和可扩展的LLM驱动数据编制框架。 DataFlow采用系统级抽象设计，可实现模块化，可重复使用，可堆肥的数据转换，并提供PyTorch风格的管道构造API用于构建可调试和可选择的数据流。框架包括近200个可重复使用的操作员和6个域通用管道，跨越文本，数学推理，代码，文本对SQL，代理RAG，以及大规模的知识提取。为了进一步提高可用性，我们引入了DataFlow-Agent，通过运营商合成，管道规划和迭代核查，自动将自然语言规格翻译为可执行管道。在6个有代表性的使用案例中，DataFlow持续改善下游LLM性能。我们的数学，代码和文本管道 超越了编译的人类数据集和专门的合成基线，在文本到SQL执行精度上 超过SynSQL， +7+ 代码基准的平均改进，在MATH， GSM8K，和 AIME 上 1-3 点增益。此外，DataFlow制作的统一10K抽样数据集使基础模型能够超越接受过1M无限指令数据培训的对应数据。这些结果表明，DataFlow为可靠，可复制，可扩展的LLM数据编制提供了实用和高性能的底板，并为未来以数据为中心的AI开发奠定了系统层面的基础。

items.title: MediaPipe: A Framework for Building Perception Pipelines
items.subtitle: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. items.detail: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. A developer needs to (a) select and develop corresponding machine learning algorithms and models, (b) build a series of prototypes and demos, (c) balance resource consumption against the quality of the solutions, and finally (d) identify and mitigate problematic cases. The MediaPipe framework addresses all of these challenges. A developer can use MediaPipe to build prototypes by combining existing perception components, to advance them to polished cross-platform applications and measure system performance and resource consumption on target platforms. We show that these features enable a developer to focus on the algorithm or model development and use MediaPipe as an environment for iteratively improving their application with results reproducible across different devices and platforms. MediaPipe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/google/mediapipe.
items.title_zh: MediaPipe：建设认知管道的框架
items.detail_zh: 建立能感知周围世界的应用是具有挑战性的。开发者需要(a) 选择和开发相应的机器学习算法和模型，(b) 建立一系列原型和演示，(c) 平衡资源消耗与解决方案质量，最后(d) 发现并缓解有问题的案例。 MediaPipe框架处理所有这些挑战。一个开发者可以使用MediaPipe通过将现有的感知组件组合起来来构建原型，以推进它们来抛光跨平台的应用程序并测量目标平台的系统性能和资源消耗。我们显示，这些特性使开发者能够专注于算法或模型开发，并使用MediaPipe作为环境来反复改进它们的应用，其结果可以在不同设备和平台上复制。 MediaPipe将在https://github.com/google/mediapipe上开源。

items.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?

items.detail: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. The benchmark spans six tasks across three levels, from static rule-based training to judge-based optimization and closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection. Two diagnostic skills, namely runtime recording and post-hoc summarization, enable structured analysis of agent behavior, facilitating smooth and effective iteration of the benchmark's evaluation framework. Across five agent systems and six driver LLMs, agents show intelligent behavior but clear limitations: one RL-oriented run improves ALFWorld from 4.85 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts, yet DeepSearchQA remains difficult, most successful routes rely on supervised pipelines, and interactive outcomes show large single-run differences across agent stacks. Overall, Agent2 RL-Bench shows that current agents can sometimes engineer online RL, but stable agent-driven RL post-training remains rare under fixed budgets. It also demonstrates that our benchmark provides a strong and effective evaluation framework for future research in this direction. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench/README.md
items.title_zh: 代理 ^2 RL- Bench： LLM 代理 工程师 代理 RL 后训练？
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Agent2 RL-Bench，这是评价代理RL后训练的紧凑诊断基准，该基准测试LLM代理是否能够自主地设计，执行，调试，以及执行改进基础模型的训练后管线。 RL后培训越来越能推动模型的对接和专业化，但现有的基准基本是静态的，奖励有监督的微调或脚本生成，而不评估代理商关闭交互式RL环的能力。 Agent2 RL-Bench提供了统一的代理-造型接口：每次运行都从一个孤立的工作空间开始，包含一个基础模型，任务数据，指令，以及一个分级的API，代理必须通过培训模型和提交文物进行评价，在固定预算范围内进行迭接。该基准跨越从静态规则培训到基于法官的优化和有轨迹收集的闭路在线RL等三个层面的6个任务。两种诊断技能，即运行时间记录和随机汇总后，能够对代理行为进行有条理的分析，促进基准评价框架的平稳和有效迭代。在五个代理系统和六个驱动程序LLMs中，代理显示智能行为，但有明显的局限性：一个面向RL的运行改进了ALFWorld，从4.85到93.28通过SFT热身和GPRO在线推出，然而DeepSearchQA仍然困难重重，大多数成功路线依赖于有监督的管线，互动结果显示各代理堆的单运行差异很大。总体而言，Agent2 RL-Bench显示，当前代理有时可以在线设计RL，但稳定代理驱动的RL后培训在固定预算下仍然罕见。它还表明，我们的基准为今后这方面的研究提供了有力而有效的评价框架。代码见https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl bench/README.md。

items.title: Raising the Cost of Malicious AI-Powered Image Editing
items.subtitle: We present an approach to mitigating the risks of malicious image editing posed by large diffusion models. The key idea is to immunize images so as to make them resistant to manipulation by these models. This immunization relies on injection of imperceptible adversarial perturbations designed to disrupt the operation of the targeted diffusion models, forcing them to generate unrealistic images. We provide two methods for crafting such perturbations, and then demonstrate their efficacy. items.detail: We present an approach to mitigating the risks of malicious image editing posed by large diffusion models. The key idea is to immunize images so as to make them resistant to manipulation by these models. This immunization relies on injection of imperceptible adversarial perturbations designed to disrupt the operation of the targeted diffusion models, forcing them to generate unrealistic images. We provide two methods for crafting such perturbations, and then demonstrate their efficacy. Finally, we discuss a policy component necessary to make our approach fully effective and practical -- one that involves the organizations developing diffusion models, rather than individual users, to implement (and support) the immunization process.
items.title_zh: 提高恶意的AI力量图像编辑的成本
items.detail_zh: 我们提出了一个减轻大规模传播模型造成的恶意图像编辑风险的办法。关键的想法是免疫图像，使其能抵抗被这些模型所操纵。这种免疫依赖于注射不易察觉的对抗性扰动来打乱目标传播模式的运作，迫使它们产生不切实际的图像。我们提供了两种方法来设计这种扰动，然后展示其效力。最后，我们讨论一个必要的政策组成部分，使我们的方法充分有效和实用 -- -- 一个涉及各组织制定传播模式，而不是个别用户，以执行(和支持)免疫进程。

items.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming

items.detail: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that layer-paradigm matching can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.
items.title_zh: 保障人工智能代理：多层代理红色团队统一框架
items.detail_zh: 开源AI基础设施的快速发展，从模型服务引擎和代理平台，到模型背景协议(MCP)生态系统和语言模型本身，都超过了可用于防御它的安全工具。我们提出AI-Infra-Guard，这是一个开源框架，它组织AI红色团队围绕一个单一的观察：AI代理的攻击表面分层分层(基础设施，协议/工具，代理行为，以及模型)，没有一个单一的检测范式适合所有这些。因此，框架将一个范式与每一层相匹配，从确定规则比75+ AI组件和1{，}400+脆弱性规则，通过LLM驱动的代理审计MCP服务器和代理技能包以及多回合黑箱代理红色组合，到26+攻击操作员超过16个数据集的越狱控制带。据我们所知，这是涵盖所有这一切的唯一开放源码框架，包括对代理技能进行供应链审计，从而日益扩展AI代理。我们释放AI-Infra-Guard作为开放源代码，这样层-paradigm匹配就可以作为代理安全的实际基础和共享的基础，让社区在此基础上更进一步。

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员：自我改进的 RLM 技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是相继的处理器，但长视机构需要外部信息并进行超出模型权重和活性上下文的计算。 Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器。持续的IPython REPL遵循了Recursive Language Model的抽象，用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算，而Continual Harness则保存了历史，记忆，技能，提示，和跨道的子剂规格。递归子剂通过直接代理对代理通信来协调，代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话。主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化，同时将战略构建留给模型。这种低温的显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障，并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力。 Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%，并在长文本编码、GPU-内核生成、模拟器构建和自主纳米GPT快跑中匹配或超过本地和受欢迎的牵引。在Instemio上，我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步，专用的子剂可以使工作并行。代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

items.title: Moonshine: Speech Recognition for Live Transcription and Voice Commands
items.subtitle: This paper introduces Moonshine, a family of speech recognition models optimized for live transcription and voice command processing. Moonshine is based on an encoder-decoder transformer architecture and employs Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) instead of traditional absolute position embeddings. The model is trained on speech segments of various lengths, but without using zero-padding, leading to greater efficiency for the encoder during inference time. When benchmarked against OpenAI's Whisper tiny.en, Moonshine Tiny demonstrates a 5x reduction in compute requirements for transcribing a 10-second speech segment while incurring no increase in word error rates across standard evaluation data
items.detail: This paper introduces Moonshine, a family of speech recognition models optimized for live transcription and voice command processing. Moonshine is based on an encoder-decoder transformer architecture and employs Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) instead of traditional absolute position embeddings. The model is trained on speech segments of various lengths, but without using zero-padding, leading to greater efficiency for the encoder during inference time. When benchmarked against OpenAI's Whisper tiny.en, Moonshine Tiny demonstrates a 5x reduction in compute requirements for transcribing a 10-second speech segment while incurring no increase in word error rates across standard evaluation datasets. These results highlight Moonshine's potential for real-time and resource-constrained applications.
items.title_zh: Moonshine：现场转写和语音命令的语音识别
items.detail_zh: 本文引入了Moonshine，一个最优化的语音识别模式家族，用于现场记录和语音指令处理。 Moonshine基于编码器-解码器变压器架构，并使用Rotary Place Embedding(ROPE)而不是传统的绝对位置嵌入。该模型以不同长度的语音段进行训练，但不使用零铺设，从而在推论期间提高了编码器的效率。当以 OpenAI 的 Whisper tiny.en 为基准时，Moonshine Tiny 显示，对转录10秒语音段的计算要求减少了5x，同时在标准评价数据集的字差率没有增加。这些结果凸显了月光公司在实时和受资源限制的应用方面的潜力。

items.detail: We present the Flavors of Moonshine, a suite of tiny automatic speech recognition (ASR) models specialized for a range of underrepresented languages. Prevailing wisdom suggests that multilingual ASR models outperform monolingual counterparts by exploiting cross-lingual phonetic similarities. We challenge this assumption, showing that for sufficiently small models (27M parameters), training monolingual systems on a carefully balanced mix of high-quality human-labeled, pseudo-labeled, and synthetic data yields substantially superior performance. On average, our models achieve error rates 48% lower than the comparably sized Whisper Tiny model, outperform the 9x larger Whisper Small model, and in most cases match or outperform the 28x larger Whisper Medium model. These results advance the state of the art for models of this size, enabling accurate on-device ASR for languages that previously had limited support. We release Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese Moonshine models under a permissive open-source license.
items.title_zh: 月光闪烁：边缘设备的小型专用ASR模型

items.title: LongCat-Video Technical Report
items.subtitle: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks
items.detail: Video generation is a critical pathway toward world models, with efficient long video inference as a key capability. Toward this end, we introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across multiple video generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models. Key features include: Unified architecture for multiple tasks: Built on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework, LongCat-Video supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks with a single model; Long video generation: Pretraining on Video-Continuation tasks enables LongCat-Video to maintain high quality and temporal coherence in the generation of minutes-long videos; Efficient inference: LongCat-Video generates 720p, 30fps videos within minutes by employing a coarse-to-fine generation strategy along both the temporal and spatial axes. Block Sparse Attention further enhances efficiency, particularly at high resolutions; Strong performance with multi-reward RLHF: Multi-reward RLHF training enables LongCat-Video to achieve performance on par with the latest closed-source and leading open-source models. Code and model weights are publicly available to accelerate progress in the field.
items.detail_zh: 视频生成是走向世界模型的关键途径，以高效的长视频推论为关键能力。为此，我们引入了"长卡特-视频"(LongCat-Video)，这是一个具有13.6B参数的基础视频生成模型，在多个视频生成任务中展现出强效。它在高效和高质量的长相视频制作方面特别出色，代表了我们走向世界模式的第一步。主要功能包括：多个任务的统一架构：构建在分化变形器(DiT)框架上，LongCat-Video支持Text-to-Video，Image-Video，以及视频连续任务，采用单一模式；长视频生成：关于视频连续任务的预训，使LongCat-Video能够在生成分钟视频时保持高质量和时间上的一致性；高效推论：LongCat-Video在几分钟内通过在时间轴和空间轴上同时使用粗到fine生成策略生成720p，30fps视频。 Block Sparse Content进一步提高了效率，特别是在高分辨率下；强效多奖RLHF：多奖RLHF训练使LongCat-Video能够以与最新封闭源码和领先开源模式等同的方式实现性能。守则和模型权重已公开提供，以加速该领域的进展。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.

items.detail_zh: 团体相对政策优化(GRPO)已被证明是培训后语言模型的有效工具。然而，AI系统越来越多地被表述为模块化程序，将多个LM调用组合在一起，并带有独特的即时模板和其他工具，目前尚不清楚如何最佳地利用GRPO来改进这些系统。我们开始通过定义mmGRPO来应对这一挑战，这是一个简单的GRPO的多模块概括，LM组通过模块逐个调用，处理可变长度和被中断的轨迹。我们发现由自动快速优化组成的 mmGRPO 提高了准确度 11% 跨分类，多跳搜索，和隐私保护任务 后训练的 LM，以及5% 的 自身快速优化。我们在DSPY开源的mmGRPO作为dspy。 GPRO优化器。

items.detail: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
items.title_zh: OpenVL Harness：真实世界视觉代理工具与多模式内存
items.detail_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展，然而许多任务需要的证据单靠内部推理是难以获得的：我们对22个基准的控制研究显示，仅仅增加基础模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益。这种任务需要有根据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字计量，其产出必须能够对模型作出解释，并保留各种推理步骤。我们引进了OpenVLHarness，这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多模式记忆而组织的多模式推理工具。能力层将任务级工具接口与证据渲染相结合，提供一致的获取多端后端的途径，并将其输出转化为可模型读取的观测。持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像，结构化数据和网络引用，作为每个查询的可地址文物。一个编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序，使计算能够结合多个工具的结果。这些机制共同支持获取、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭接进程。对22个有8个开放和专有骨干的基准进行评估后，OpenVLHarness的平均分数比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分，包括+11.2分与Qune3-VL-8B分，+9.7分与Kimi K3分，+9.9分与GPT-6 Astra分。随着GPT-6 Luna在中度推理上的努力，OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的功率超过了基准模型"Codex"和"Visual Sketchpad"，同时以最多37%的模型脚本成本承担成本。

items.detail: Computer use agents automate digital tasks by directly interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) on computers and mobile devices, offering significant potential to enhance human productivity by completing an open-ended space of user queries. However, current agents face significant challenges: imprecise grounding of GUI elements, difficulties with long-horizon task planning, and performance bottlenecks from relying on single generalist models for diverse cognitive tasks. To this end, we introduce Agent S2, a novel compositional framework that delegates cognitive responsibilities across various generalist and specialist models. We propose a novel Mixture-of-Grounding technique to achieve precise GUI localization and introduce Proactive Hierarchical Planning, dynamically refining action plans at multiple temporal scales in response to evolving observations. Evaluations demonstrate that Agent S2 establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on three prominent computer use benchmarks. Specifically, Agent S2 achieves 18.9% and 32.7% relative improvements over leading baseline agents such as Claude Computer Use and UI-TARS on the OSWorld 15-step and 50-step evaluation. Moreover, Agent S2 generalizes effectively to other operating systems and applications, surpassing previous best methods by 52.8% on WindowsAgentArena and by 16.52% on AndroidWorld relatively. Code available at https://github.com/simular-ai/Agent-S.
items.title_zh: S2：计算机使用代理人的构成通用-专门框架
items.detail_zh: 计算机使用代理人通过直接与计算机和移动设备上的图形用户界面(GUIs)互动，实现数字任务的自动化，通过完成一个开放的用户查询空间，为提高人的生产力提供了巨大潜力。然而，目前的代理人面临重大挑战：图形用户界面要素的基础不准确，长期任务规划有困难，以及不同认知任务依赖单一的通论模式所产生的性能瓶颈。为此，我们引入了S2特工(Agent S2)，这是一种全新的组成框架，将认知责任分散到各种通论模式和专家模式。我们提出一种新型的 " 组合 " 技术，以实现精确的图形用户界面本地化，并采用积极主动的分级规划，根据不断发展的观测结果，在多时范围内动态地完善行动计划。评估表明，S2代理公司在三个著名的计算机使用基准上建立了新的先进(SOTA)性能。具体来说，S2代理公司在OSWorld 15步和50步评价上比克劳德计算机使用和UI-TARS等主要基线代理公司实现18.9%和32.7%的相对改进。此外，Agent S2有效地概括到其他操作系统和应用上，在Windows AgentArena上比以往最佳方法高出52.8%，在AndroidWorld上比16.52%。代码见https://github.com/simular-ai/Agent-S。

items.detail: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.
items.title_zh: GTAGym： AAA 游戏任务环境用于评价和加强学习
items.detail_zh: AAA游戏为评价代理感知，推理，控制提供了丰富的测试床。然而，评估代理商能否完成AAA游戏中的任务是具有挑战性的，而且常常是人为附加说明的，因为任务结果往往难以自动核实，更不要说应用它来强化学习(RL)。我们介绍了GTAGym，这是一个关于GTA V任务的评估和RL的环境和框架。其评价基准GTAV Bench源于GTA V主楼任务，包含103项在线任务，重建跨越9个任务家族，同时使用GTA V图像进行47项基于图像的射击和狙击任务。一个网络服务器提供在线环境和评价界面的接入，通过截图和键盘-mouse动作支持并行测试，并自动进行引擎状态结果检查。我们评价了GTAV Bench上的6个前沿LLMs，并附有文字任务指令及其GTAV Bench-AGI分支，这些指令只出现在第一个截图中，一个带会自动压缩交互历史。最佳配置在GTAV Bench-AGI中达到70.9%的总精度，然而空中导航，逃逸和拦截仍然很困难。 GTAGym还提供了一个可缩放的生成器，在用户指定范围和选项集内在固定模板下对任务参数进行样本，为RL创建了一批基于3D和图像的射击环境，并带有自动奖励和终止信号。 LORA RL of Quen3.8-27B on-foot导航任务生成，改善了域内性能和向域外任务类别转移，本地GTA V任务从15%到23%。

items.detail: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher's CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.
items.title_zh: VidDub：双步视频 Dubing 的替换- 软件分级
items.detail_zh: 视频配音旨在合成与目标演讲相匹配的口语动作，现有的编辑器主要通过在原配对音频下进行自建来训练，尽管在驾驶语音被替换时源口会成为相冲突的目标。我们引入了重置意识跨音频监督：配对-音频样本采用全帧重建，而未配对的重置-音频样本掩盖了源口重建损失，仅通过视听同步来监督口腔，同时保留了未蒙面的面部区域和背景。因为离线配音提前提供了完整的源视频和目标演讲，所以我们呈现出VidDub，一个完整的通则传播编辑器蒸馏出两个去诺化步骤(2个NFE)。我们的替代意识老师首先学会准确的口语同步，而不向相冲突的源口运动倒退。相匹配的轨迹回归后再将老师的CFG制导轨迹转移给双步生，分布相匹配的蒸馏在相继压缩后会恢复视觉质量。我们将公布经整理的培训数据集VidDub-Bench、固定对接和跨音频评价清单、预处理产出和统一评价代码。在三个培训种子中，掩盖相互冲突的源口重建使跨声道Sync-C改进了0.833；最后的两步模式结合了强口同步与优异视觉质量，身份保存，视觉语音识别四个基准。

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.subtitle: Public repository for Agent Skills
items.detail: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.
items.subtitle_zh: 代理技能公共仓库
items.detail_zh: 技能是克劳德动态地加载以提高专业任务性能的指令，脚本和资源的文件夹。技能教克洛德如何以可重复的方式完成具体的任务，无论是用你的公司的品牌准则创建文件，利用你的组织的具体工作流程分析数据，还是将个人任务自动化。这个寄存器包含了能展示克劳德的技能系统所可能具备的技能。这些技能从创意应用(艺术，音乐，设计)到技术任务(测试网络应用，MCP服务器生成)到企业工作流程(通信，品牌等)。每种技能都自成一体地放入自己的文件夹，其中包含克洛德使用的指令和元数据的一个SKILL.md文件。通过这些技能来浏览以获得对自身技能的启发或理解不同的模式和方法。

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.subtitle: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
items.detail: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app. OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative: an independent project inspired by Grok Bot, and the open-source alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and Cue by Manus — bring-your-own-agent, local-first, on the models you already have. Also known as MausBot; formerly OpenGrokBot. Not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus. Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps. Talk to them like contacts. Watch them work. Approve what matters.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.subtitle: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
items.detail: Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.subtitle: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.detail: Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question. To run a text-to-SQL benchmark such as BIRD, refer to the ontology SQL evaluation repository.
items.subtitle_zh: 自动本体学(Auto Ontology)是一个Python框架，用于构建语义性，基于图表的推理层凌驾于数据之上。它能够生成决定性的查询，更好的上下文检索，以及更能解释LLM和代理工作流程的AI。
items.detail_zh: 代理人可以检索文档和查询数据库，但可靠性门代理分析：如果数字错误，更快地回答一个收入指标就无价值。代理商需要一个上下文层，来告诉他们数据在哪里生活，它意味着什么，是否使用它，如何使用它，它从哪里来，什么是相似的。 NVIDIA Auto Ontology是一个开放的库，它从企业元数据中构建该层，调和跨系统的定义，并通过MCP，CLI和API将其暴露在任何代理机上。它补充了已经拥有的语义模型客户。学习：将认证的校正和用法折回本体学，因此共享上下文随每个问题而改善。要运行BIRD等文本对SQL基准，请参考本体学SQL评价寄存器。

items.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
items.subtitle: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
items.detail: MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. MuJoCo has a C API and is intended for researchers and developers. The runtime simulation module is tuned to maximize performance and operates on low-level data structures that are preallocated by the built-in XML compiler. The library includes interactive visualization in native desktop windows and web browsers. MuJoCo further exposes a large number of utility functions for computing physics-related quantities. We also provide [Python bindings] and a plug-in for the [Unity] game engine.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.subtitle: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.detail: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from. 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needsvalidation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier. 6. Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.
items.subtitle_zh: 分阶段执行安全审计的 Coding Agent Skill：通过架构侦察、覆盖率驱动的缺陷搜索、独立验证和机器可读的发现记录，提高安全审计的可追溯性。
items.detail_zh: 将你的经纪人变成安全审计师 它通过侦察、以覆盖为主导的狩猎、候选人验证、结构化产出、独立记录核查以及目标中立的报告，协调孤立的特工。这是Cloudflare的弱点发现工具的种子，在Build自己的弱点工具中描述。牵引力已发展为多阶段，全舰队范围的系统；这种技能是从它演化出来的单回波起步。 1。侦察 -- -- 地图建筑、信任边界、输入表面、先前证据和结构的确定性覆盖。 2。覆盖为主导的狩猎 -- -- 从分类单元中指派孤立的猎人，记录他们的支票，利用覆盖批评者寻找漏洞。 3。候选人验证 -- -- 将每个独特的候选人交给一个新的核查人，以试图反驳。 4。结构化产出 -- -- 书面确认，需要验证，并拒绝对调查结果的记录。 5。独立记录核查 -- -- 新鲜剂核查最终来源申报。物料替换器接收到另一个独立的验证器。 6。目标中性报告 -- -- 从经核实的记录和覆盖分类账中取出报告(m)，FindingS-DETAIL.m和NeedS-Validation.m。

items.detail: Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.

Free, MIT, no signup, no API key. The tools are plain Python that read free public data: Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq Trader's symbol lists, SEC EDGAR and the House Clerk. One scans thousands of charts for setups. Another tracks breaking news on every stock you watch. One watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment to get in, and another sets your stop and your target before you do. And the craziest one is the Time Machine: before you risk a dollar, it replays the rest of the session 10,000 times from the stock's own recent bars, plus every past day the same setup fired, and tells you the honest odds.

items.subtitle: UI design skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents: explore distinct directions, compare them side by side, refine against real screenshots. 给 AI Agent 用的 UI 设计 Skill。
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.subtitle: AI生成の日本語を自然な日本語へ推敲するAgent Skill / Agent Skill for Refining AI-Generated Japanese into Natural Japanese
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Claude Code、Codex、CursorをはじめとするAIコーディング環境に読み込ませて使用してください。本体を入れられない環境のために、本体を短くした yomiyasu-mini と yomiyasu-pocket も公開しています（本体を入れられない環境では）。 文章を生成するAIは日常的な道具となりました。 一方で、AIで生成された文章には独特のクセが残りやすく、そのままでは実務や技術発信に使いにくい場面が多くあります。 1. 禁止語の置き換えにとどまる対処 「手触り」「解像度」「泥臭い」といった表層の単語を禁止しても、別の曖昧な語へ置き換わるだけで、不自然な文構造そのものは解消されませんでした。 2. 編集ルールの過剰適用 修辞の規範を与えすぎると、モデルが指示を過剰に解釈し、かえって不自然な造語や大げさな文体を招いていました。 3. 主述関係の曖昧さと非生物主語 誰が何をどうするのかが省略されたまま、概念や道具が比喩的な動詞（壊れる、倒す、効くなど）と結びつき、読み手が文脈を大きく補って読む必要がありました。 4. 形式の偏重と情報密度の低下 太字や箇条書きが増える一方で、手順やコードの仕組みといった核心の部分は抽象的に書かれ、文章の量に比べて実際の情報が少なくなっていました。

items.title: hajdu-patrik/trirouter
items.subtitle: AI-powered multi-model workspace and routing system for Claude, Codex and other LLM agents. Provides intelligent prompt routing, agent orchestration, evaluation workflows, CLI integrations, MCP tooling and developer productivity automation.
items.author: Python
items.detail: trirouter runs before every prompt you send to Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Google Antigravity – in every project, in the desktop apps and in remote sessions – and decides for that single request: It also protects running work: a prompt sent while an earlier one is still being processed is told to finish that work first, never stop or overwrite it. Decisions come from JEV (TypeSafe) when you configure a TypeSafe token or an OpenRouter key; without one a built-in local classifier decides, so everything works out of the box. Setup detects the tools, takes an optional JEV key, connects hooks and the MCP server, installs the trirouter command with tab completion, moves every tool's skills into the shared ~/.skills folder (scanned with SkillSpector when installed), generates the worker agents and offers remote access. Every change is shown first, changed config files keep a .bak, re-running is safe.

items.detail: OpenBUA was asked to "Find me 2 students from Australia using Linkedin and email them selling my app Petedoro" OpenBUA (Open Browser Use Agent) is an open-source, autonomous AI browser agent built as a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that runs directly inside your everyday browser. Built with @earendil-works/pi-agent-core and @earendil-works/pi-ai, OpenBUA equips AI models with real-time DOM perception, intelligent multi-step navigation, synthetic event form-filling, incremental live research previews, and a self-learning memory system.

items.detail: AgentFlow 将执行、评估、失败反馈、候选变异、有限预算搜索与验证选版连起来。进化对象包含节点指令、训练经验示例与受限 DAG 拓扑；模型权重不变。结构搜索可在单节点、路由/优先级双专家、初判后复核之间选版，不等同于任意图生成。 固定模型、业务规则和执行参数，对比固定指令、反馈随机搜索、反馈 GP/EI，并加入固定 few-shot 基线。每轮生成三个候选，只评估两个；两轮共评估四个新候选。测试集不参与变异或选版。 数据为 48 条自建模拟工单：12 训练 / 12 验证 / 24 测试，同一业务规则下样本互不重复。不是客户生产数据，也不是 BFCL 官方测评。报告包含原始输出、候选谱系、输入/输出 Token、失败实验和统计区间。

items.detail_en: AgentFlow links implementation, assessment, failure feedback, candidate variations, limited budget search and validation of selected versions. The evolutionary object contains nodal instructions, examples of training experience and limited DAG scale; model weights change. Structural searches can be selected between single nodes, route/priority experts, and post-preliminary reviews, and do not amount to arbitrary production. Fixed models, business rules and implementation parameters, comparison of fixed instructions, random search of feedback, feedback GP/EI and addition of a fixed few-shot baseline. Three candidates per round, only two; two rounds, four new candidates. Test set does not participate in variation or selection. The data is 48 self-built simulators: 12 Training / 12 Validation / 24 Tests, with no repetition of samples under the same operational rules. It's not customer production data, it's not an official BFCL assessment. The report contains original output, candidate spectrum, input/output Token, failed experiments and statistical ranges.
